blocks.x: We are filming today a jazz interview for the Hamilton College Archives, and we are here with Benny Powell, one of the great jazz trombone players. Pleasure to have you.
Thank you very much. Here in New York City.

We want to ask you some things about jazz, about some things maybe that young people don’t know today, and see if you can fill us in and tell us some things in your career that guided you along the way, and some aspects, I also want to talk about some aspects of oral culture. How old were you when you first started playing?
